description: Lists the grain commodity slugs this API tracks (corn, soybeans, wheat, sorghum, oats, barley, rice) with display labels. Use to discover valid `product` values before calling get_grain_price or get_grain_history. Read-only; no API key. The list is the configured MARS catalog, not a live availability check — a listed product can still have no report for a given state.
name: list_grain_products
